requirement.description: The Tags class constructor accepts invalid argument types that should raise TypeError but currently doesn't. In test_json_tags, JobDefinition and Table classes expect TypeError to be raised when Tags parameter is passed as dict or string, but the validation logic is missing in the validation chain.
requirement.contract: When creating JobDefinition or Table objects with Tags parameter, the implementation should validate that Tags parameter is an instance of the Tags class or AWSHelperFn. Invalid types (dict, string) should raise TypeError with descriptive message.

requirement.description: The JobDefinition class doesn't validate Tags parameter properly. It should only accept Tags objects or AWSHelperFn instances.
requirement.contract: The JobDefinition class constructor should validate that Tags parameter is either a Tags object or AWSHelperFn instance. Passing dict or string should raise TypeError.

requirement.description: The Table class doesn't validate Tags parameter properly. It should only accept Tags objects or AWSHelperFn instances.
requirement.contract: The Table class constructor should validate that Tags parameter is either a Tags object or AWSHelperFn instance. Passing dict or string should raise TypeError.
